invariants.text: Product.product_id must be an auto-incremented integer primary key with default value None
User.user_id must be an auto-incremented integer primary key with default value None
Sale.sale_id must be an auto-incremented integer primary key with default value None
Sale.product_id must reference an existing Product.product_id
Sale.user_id must reference an existing User.user_id
The stock quantity of a product must not go below zero after a sale.
The quantity of a product sold in a sale must not exceed the product's current stock quantity at the time of the sale.
The sum of all quantities sold for a product across all sales must equal the difference between the initial stock quantity and the current stock quantity.
A sale can only be recorded if the product's stock quantity is sufficient to cover the sale quantity.
The stock quantity of a product is updated only when a sale is successfully recorded.
